name: Homunculus Hotel
source:
Homunculus Hotel is a visual novel composed of 6 stories. As Isabelle, your task is to visit the guests of the hotel's various floors, talk with them and help them understand the dreams that their rooms show them. Unable to see her dream, though, she tries to console herself with the memories of her ex-fiancée between one day's sessions and the next.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796640/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Homunculus Hotel》是一部由6个故事组成的视觉小说。作为伊莎贝尔，你的任务是拜访酒店各个楼层的客人，与他们交谈并帮助他们了解房间向他们展示的梦想。然而，她看不到自己的梦想，在一天的治疗和第二天的治疗之间，她试图用对前未婚妻的回忆来安慰自己。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796640/]Steam[/url]]
